about.title: Deep Cultivator and Leader in Lightning Protection & Grounding
about.description: Since our founding in 1993, Green Electric has steadfastly resisted the temptation of diversification, focusing exclusively on lightning protection and grounding systems. We don't just provide products—we are committed to delivering one-stop systematic solutions covering the entire industrial chain from interception, down conductors to grounding for global industrial facilities.

story.title: Spanning Three Decades, Unwavering Commitment, Consistent Excellence
story.paragraph1: Green Electric was born in Wuxi, China in 1993. From day one, we established a long-term strategic focus on "lightning protection and grounding technology." Over the past three decades, regardless of industry trends, we have never deviated from this core path. Through our relentless pursuit of safety standards, we have built a professional and pure brand reputation in the industrial protection sector.
story.paragraph2: We understand that true industrial safety is not about simply stacking components, but about perfect synergy within the system. Therefore, we continuously conduct deep R&D on every physical connection "from air terminals to ground electrodes," ensuring that lightning current can be safely, precisely, and efficiently conducted into the earth under extreme geographical and climatic conditions.
story.paragraph3: Today, Green Electric has grown into the preferred specialized supplier for global EPC projects. From advanced ESE early streamer emission lightning rods and electrolytic ion grounding electrodes to precision igniters and exothermic welding consumables, we remain focused on the deep supply of specialized lightning protection and grounding materials. This has been our foundation for the past thirty years; for the next century, our commitment remains unchanged as we continue to safeguard every critical infrastructure.

lws.title: Lightning Warning System
lws.subtitle: Atmospheric Electric Field Monitoring
lws.description: Comprehensive atmospheric electric field monitoring, providing 20 minutes advance warning time for lightning activities.
lws.introduction1: The Green Lightning Warning System is an advanced atmospheric electric field monitoring device that can detect changes in atmospheric electric field intensity in real-time and accurately predict the occurrence of lightning activities. Through high-precision sensors and intelligent algorithms, the system can issue early warnings 20 minutes before lightning strikes, providing valuable time for personnel evacuation and equipment protection.
lws.introduction2: The system adopts a multi-level warning mechanism, automatically triggering different levels of alarms based on the intensity of atmospheric electric field changes. When the electric field intensity reaches a preset threshold, the system will issue sound and light alarms and can be linked with other safety systems to achieve automatic power-off, equipment shutdown and other protective measures, minimizing the losses caused by lightning.
lws.feature1: Real-time monitoring of atmospheric electric field intensity changes, accurately capturing lightning formation signals.
lws.feature2: AI intelligent algorithm based on big data analysis, accurately predicting lightning activity 20 minutes in advance.
lws.feature3: Multi-level graded warning mechanism, providing different levels of alerts based on lightning intensity.
lws.feature4: Supports multiple alarm methods including sound, light, SMS and network push notifications.
lws.feature5: Can be linked with automation systems to achieve automatic power-off and equipment protection.
lws.feature6: Remote monitoring and management via web platform and mobile APP.
lws.tech1Desc: Real-time monitoring of atmospheric electric field intensity changes, accurately capturing lightning formation signals
lws.tech2Desc: AI algorithm based on big data, accurately warning of lightning activity 20 minutes in advance
lws.tech3Desc: Graded warning system, providing different levels of alerts based on lightning intensity
lws.warningLevelSubtitle: Electric field intensity threshold and corresponding warning level

ese.title: Early Streamer Emission Lightning Rod
ese.subtitle: Active Lightning Attraction Technology
ese.description: Active lightning attraction technology, expanding protection radius through early streamer emission.
ese.introduction1: The RZ-T Green Early Streamer Emission Lightning Rod works by generating an upward leader faster than ordinary lightning rods. Before the natural upward leader forms, the RZ-T ESE lightning rod will first generate a leader that quickly propagates towards the lightning direction until it captures the lightning and conducts it to the ground. Laboratory tests have confirmed that the earlier generation of the upward leader, known as the initiation advance time ΔT, gives the RZ-T ESE lightning rod a more effective lightning protection function.
ese.introduction2: Note: This description only describes negative downward lightning strikes. Under the same conditions, the rapidly approaching upward leader discharge potential is also tens of thousands of volts lower than ordinary lightning rods, meaning the RZ-T ESE lightning rod has lower lightning discharge energy and lower instantaneous grounding impulse current, which is the only application example of the electrical-geometric model. So far, this type of lightning strike is the most frequent.
ese.feature1: Complies with GB50057 Building Lightning Protection Design Code and NFC17-102 French National Lightning Protection Standard.
ese.feature5: Fully compatible with "Green" lightning protection system accessories, optional metal strips, wires and anti-cable down conductors.
ese.tech1Desc: Actively generates upward leader, intercepts lightning current in advance, expands protection radius
ese.tech2Desc: Optimized electrode design, significantly improving lightning attraction efficiency and reliability
ese.tech3Desc: Aviation grade stainless steel, ensuring long-term stable operation in harsh environments

cbr.title: Copper-Bonded Steel Grounding Rod
cbr.subtitle: High-Efficiency Grounding Solution
cbr.description: Perfect combination of high-conductivity copper layer and high-strength steel core, providing durable and reliable grounding performance.
cbr.introduction1: Green Copper-Bonded Steel Grounding Rod adopts advanced electroplating process to uniformly cover high-purity copper layer on high-quality low-carbon steel core. The copper layer thickness reaches 0.25mm or more, ensuring excellent conductivity and corrosion resistance. The steel core provides strong mechanical strength, enabling the grounding rod to withstand impact force during deep burial installation.
cbr.introduction2: Copper-bonded steel grounding rod is one of the most commonly used grounding materials in modern grounding systems, widely used in power systems, communication base stations, petrochemical industry, building lightning protection and other fields. Compared with pure copper grounding rods, copper-bonded steel grounding rods have higher cost-effectiveness while maintaining good conductivity and corrosion resistance.
cbr.feature1: Copper layer thickness ≥0.25mm, excellent conductivity, stable grounding resistance.
cbr.feature2: Electroplating process, copper-steel molecular bonding, will not peel off.
cbr.feature3: High strength steel core, can be deeply buried, suitable for various geological conditions.
cbr.feature4: Strong corrosion resistance, service life up to 30 years or more.
cbr.feature5: Flexible connection methods, supports exothermic welding, crimping and other connection methods.
cbr.feature6: Complies with UL467, IEC62561 and other international standards.
cbr.tech1Desc: Copper-steel molecular level bonding, ensuring firm bonding between copper layer and steel core, will not peel off
cbr.tech2Desc: Copper layer purity above 99.9%, conductivity close to pure copper, stable grounding resistance
cbr.tech3Desc: Copper layer forms protective film, effectively resisting soil corrosion, service life up to 30 years

iwp.title: Igniter & Welding Powder
iwp.subtitle: Exothermic Welding Solution
iwp.description: Molecular-level welding connection, achieving permanent electrical continuity.
iwp.introduction1: Green Exothermic Welding System consists of electronic igniter and dedicated welding powder, which is an efficient and reliable electrical connection method. Through the high temperature (about 2500°C) generated by thermite reaction, copper, steel and other metals are melted and fused to form molecular-level connections. The welded joint has the same conductivity as the conductor, will not age, loosen or corrode.
iwp.introduction2: The electronic igniter provides a safe and convenient remote ignition method, allowing operators to start the welding process from a safe distance, avoiding high temperature burn risks. The welding powder uses high-purity copper oxide and aluminum powder formula to ensure stable and reliable welding quality. Exothermic welding is widely used in grounding systems, lightning protection engineering, power facilities and other fields for conductor connections.
iwp.feature1: Molecular-level welding, joint resistance close to zero, excellent conductivity.
iwp.feature2: Welding temperature up to 2500°C, can weld copper, steel and other metals.
iwp.feature3: Electronic remote ignition, safe operation, avoiding high temperature burn risks.
iwp.feature4: Welded joint corrosion resistant, service life same as conductor.
iwp.feature5: No external power required, suitable for various construction environments.
iwp.feature6: Complies with IEC62561, UL467 and other international standards.

ews.title: Exothermic Welding Series
ews.subtitle: Permanent Molecular-Level Connections
ews.description: Achieve molecular-level connections through exothermic reaction, providing permanent electrical continuity that never loosens or corrodes. The ideal solution for grounding system conductor connections.
ews.introduction1: Exothermic welding is a process that uses the high temperature (over 2500°C) generated by the chemical reaction between metal oxides and reducing agents to melt and fuse conductors together. This creates a molecular-level bond that is permanent and has the same conductivity as the original conductor.
ews.introduction2: Unlike mechanical connections that can loosen over time or crimp connections that may corrode, exothermic welding creates a fusion bond that will never loosen, corrode, or increase in resistance. The welded joint can withstand repeated fault currents and has a service life equal to that of the conductor itself.
ews.introduction3: Our exothermic welding series includes a complete range of molds, welding powders, and ignition systems suitable for various connection types including wire-to-wire, wire-to-rod, wire-to-flat, and flat-to-flat connections. All products comply with IEC 62561, UL 467, and IEEE 80 standards.

ews.feature3: Permanent connection that never loosens or corrodes
